new.lead: Request a company we do not have data for yet. Once approved it is collected, checked and built; then it can be queried in research.
new.codeHint: Six digits, Shanghai / Shenzhen / Beijing A shares.
new.codeInvalid: A security code has six digits.
new.codeUnknown: This code is not a Shanghai / Shenzhen / Beijing A share, or it is mistyped.

new.fresh: There is no data for this company yet, and nobody is requesting it.
new.watch: This company is on the watch list: no approval is needed, it goes straight into the queue.
new.needsApproval: After submitting, an admin has to approve.
new.hasData: We already have data for this company.
new.updateHint: If the data looks old (a new annual report is out, for example), you can request an update.
new.mine: You have already requested this company and it is still in progress.
new.join: Someone is already requesting this company and it is still in progress.
new.others: {n, plural, =1 {1 person wants it} other {# people want it}}
